description: Completed 4-hour/day/week external liquidity with five-minute acceptance or sweep-rejection, contracted FVG consequent-encroachment retest, separate five-minute reacceleration, structural invalidation, and genuine external targets

cost_assumptions.latency_rationale: Sub-minute latency is not identifiable in one-minute OHLC. Entry is offered at the observed five-minute reacceleration close only after a completed contracted retest; fills retain full 6 bp per-fill cost and adverse-tick reserve.

validation_protocol.revision_scope: One controlled entry-sequence revision from the frozen range-FVG first-week failure: midpoint touch is no longer sufficient; a contracted retest and later five-minute displacement are mandatory.
validation_protocol.first_window_role: Rapid logic and opportunity screen only. It cannot promote the candidate by itself.
validation_protocol.screen_windows: Reuse the three BTC weeks fixed before candidate-08 outcomes were observed.
validation_protocol.promotion_rule: All three BTC weeks must be cost-after positive with sufficient opportunity, no execution failures, and no residual exposure before long evaluation.
validation_protocol.no_target_fallback: Every target remains an unconsumed completed 4-hour/day/week external level; no fitted R projection is permitted.
